description: This circular walk explores the area around the Northumberland village of Whitley Chapel. It's a varied walk with farmland, woodland trails, meadow and a waterside section along the Devil's Water. You can start and finish the walk at the parking area next to the primary school in the village. The area is good for wildlife spotting with deer, squirrels, rabbits and various woodland birds to look out for. The walk can be extended by heading a short distance south east to explore Slalely Forest .
